ipa.curves.forward_curves.ShiftScenario

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.forward_curves.ShiftScenario.

Syntax

ShiftScenario(
    *,
    par_rate_shift: ParRateShift | None = None,
    shift_tag: str | None = None,
    zc_curve_shift: dict | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
par_rate_shift ParRateShift | None No None Scenario of par rates shift (shift applied to constituents).
shift_tag str | None No None User defined string to identify the shift scenario tag. it can be used to link output curve to the shift scenario. only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. optional.
zc_curve_shift dict | None No None Collection of shift parameters tenor. "all" selector supported as well.
